original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read Model section 1 of the three-register bound and identify the exact excluded free operations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: First compare the alphabet, role count and length with the fully replayed #1974 census and #2027 mixed-root tariff. Identify a changed premise and a legal native implementation; then price one smallest completed instance before searching larger words.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.
Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.

actual_scope: Exact paid-call minimum for diag([s],[t],[st]) on three arbitrary dirty registers in M_3(F2[S3]), with paid labels s=(12), t=(23), every rank-one idempotent N in M_3(F2), and free scalar GL_3(F2) mixing normalized at the boundary.
scope_change_reason: The card allows one specified nonabelian operation family. This session fixes S3, its two transposition labels, and one mixed three-role endpoint distinct from the completed two-role S3 census and the completed mixed S3 triple census. No other card premise changes.
bottleneck_link: This tests call sharing in a finite nonabelian bit-register alphabet. The exact floor equals the optimistic direct bill, so this target cannot improve the bit primitive; no mapping to the selected rational-frame supplier is established.
stop_rule: Prove q >= 4 for every normalized word via a representation-rank inequality and verify a full F2[S3] four-call witness. Stop as soon as the lower bound matches the direct bill; do not search longer words.
evidence: The two-dimensional faithful representation of S3 sends each paid transposition update to a rank-one perturbation on the six-dimensional represented register space, while the named endpoint differs from identity by rank four. Telescoping proves q >= 4 uniformly over all words and all 28 rank-one idempotents. A four-call formal group-algebra witness attains the bound; verify.py checks the group/representation, all idempotents, the rank counts, the full witness, and four deletion controls. The SHA-256 of ASSEMBLY.json matches the selected record certificate_sha256. The selected source manifest path is pinned from the launch base in SOURCES.json; its 13 package roots / 1,579 file pins were not fully checked by the prescribed baseline because this worktree is sparse.
